family.description: This family is fused to a C-terminal RNA binding Pelota domain, [pfam:PF01248] [[cite:PUB00066658]]. These genes are found in the biosynthetic operon associated with the Ter stress response operon and are predicted to be involved in the biosynthesis of a ribo-nucleoside involved in stress response [[cite:PUB00066658]].
family.name: Tellurite-like stress resistance cysteine protease StiP
